command.content:
#!/bin/bash
# PORTABLE VERSION - dynamically detects database and creates project-specific backups

# Find .env file
find_env_file() {
    local dir="$PWD"
    while [ "$dir" != "/" ]; do
        if [ -f "$dir/.env" ]; then
            echo "$dir/.env"
            return 0
        fi
        dir=$(dirname "$dir")
    done
    return 1
}

ENV_FILE=$(find_env_file)

if [ -z "$ENV_FILE" ]; then
    echo "❌ .env file not found"
    echo "   Please run this from a project directory"
    exit 1
fi

PROJECT_DIR=$(dirname "$ENV_FILE")
PROJECT_NAME=$(basename "$PROJECT_DIR" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]' | tr ' ' '-')

# Source .env file to get database credentials
set -a
source "$ENV_FILE" 2>/dev/null || {
    echo "❌ Failed to source .env file"
    exit 1
}
set +a

# Use environment variables with defaults
DB_USER="${POSTGRES_USER:-memory_admin}"
DB_NAME="${POSTGRES_DB:-claude_memory}"

# Find database container
PREFIX=$(echo "$PROJECT_NAME" | cut -d'-' -f1)
DB_CONTAINER=$(docker ps --filter "name=$PREFIX" --format "{{.Names}}" | grep -E "db|postgres|mysql" | head -1)

if [ -z "$DB_CONTAINER" ]; then
    DB_CONTAINER=$(docker ps --format "{{.Names}}" | grep -E "db|postgres|mysql" | head -1)
fi

if [ -z "$DB_CONTAINER" ]; then
    echo "❌ Database container not found"
    echo "   Searched for containers matching: $PREFIX-*db, *postgres*, *mysql*"
    exit 1
fi

# Check if it's PostgreSQL or MySQL
DB_TYPE=""
if docker exec "$DB_CONTAINER" psql --version > /dev/null 2>&1; then
    DB_TYPE="postgresql"
elif docker exec "$DB_CONTAINER" mysql --version > /dev/null 2>&1; then
    DB_TYPE="mysql"
else
    echo "❌ Unknown database type"
    exit 1
fi

# Backup directory (use first argument or default)
BACKUP_DIR="${1:-$PROJECT_DIR/backups}"
TIMESTAMP=$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S)

mkdir -p "$BACKUP_DIR"

echo "=== Database Backup ==="
echo "Project: $PROJECT_NAME"
echo "Container: $DB_CONTAINER"
echo "Database: $DB_NAME ($DB_TYPE)"
echo "Backup directory: $BACKUP_DIR"
echo ""

BACKUP_FILE="$BACKUP_DIR/${PROJECT_NAME}_${DB_NAME}_${TIMESTAMP}.sql.gz"

if [ "$DB_TYPE" = "postgresql" ]; then
    echo "Creating PostgreSQL backup..."
    if docker exec "$DB_CONTAINER" pg_dump -U "$DB_USER" -d "$DB_NAME" 2>/dev/null | gzip > "$BACKUP_FILE"; then
        echo "✅ Backup created successfully"
    else
        echo "❌ Backup failed"
        rm -f "$BACKUP_FILE"
        exit 1
    fi
elif [ "$DB_TYPE" = "mysql" ]; then
    echo "Creating MySQL backup..."
    if docker exec "$DB_CONTAINER" mysqldump -u "$DB_USER" -p"${MYSQL_PASSWORD}" "$DB_NAME" 2>/dev/null | gzip > "$BACKUP_FILE"; then
        echo "✅ Backup created successfully"
    else
        echo "❌ Backup failed"
        rm -f "$BACKUP_FILE"
        exit 1
    fi
fi

echo ""
echo "Backup file: $BACKUP_FILE"
ls -lh "$BACKUP_FILE"

echo ""
echo "=== Backup Complete ==="
echo ""
echo "To restore this backup:"
if [ "$DB_TYPE" = "postgresql" ]; then
    echo "  gunzip < $BACKUP_FILE | docker exec -i $DB_CONTAINER psql -U $DB_USER -d $DB_NAME"
elif [ "$DB_TYPE" = "mysql" ]; then
    echo "  gunzip < $BACKUP_FILE | docker exec -i $DB_CONTAINER mysql -u $DB_USER -p $DB_NAME"
fi

command.content:
#!/bin/bash

echo "=== Project Volume Safety Check ==="
echo ""
echo "Date: $(date)"
echo ""

# Detect current project from docker-compose.yml
if [ ! -f "docker-compose.yml" ]; then
    echo "❌ No docker-compose.yml found in current directory"
    echo "   Please run this from a docker-compose project root"
    exit 1
fi

# Extract project name from docker-compose or directory name
if command -v docker-compose >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    PROJECT_NAME=$(docker-compose config --services 2>/dev/null | head -1 | cut -d'-' -f1 || basename "$PWD" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]' | tr -d ' ')
else
    PROJECT_NAME=$(basename "$PWD" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]' | tr -d ' ')
fi

echo "Detected Project: $PROJECT_NAME"
echo "Project Directory: $PWD"
echo ""

# Find all volumes for this project
echo "--- Discovering Project Volumes ---"
PROJECT_VOLUMES=$(docker volume ls --filter "name=$PROJECT_NAME" --format "{{.Name}}")

if [ -z "$PROJECT_VOLUMES" ]; then
    echo "⚠️  WARNING: No volumes found for project '$PROJECT_NAME'"
    echo "   This may indicate:"
    echo "   • Fresh installation (no volumes created yet)"
    echo "   • Volumes were removed"
    echo "   • Project name mismatch"
    echo ""

    # Show all volumes to help debug
    echo "All available volumes:"
    docker volume ls --format "table {{.Name}}\t{{.Driver}}\t{{.Scope}}"
    exit 1
fi

echo "Found $(echo "$PROJECT_VOLUMES" | wc -l | xargs) volume(s):"
echo ""

# Analyze each volume
TOTAL_SIZE=0
CRITICAL_VOLUMES=()

for vol in $PROJECT_VOLUMES; do
    # Get volume details
    CREATED=$(docker volume inspect "$vol" --format "{{.CreatedAt}}" 2>/dev/null | cut -d'T' -f1)
    MOUNTPOINT=$(docker volume inspect "$vol" --format "{{.Mountpoint}}" 2>/dev/null)

    # Calculate size (this might require sudo on some systems)
    if [ -n "$MOUNTPOINT" ] && [ -d "$MOUNTPOINT" ]; then
        SIZE=$(sudo du -sh "$MOUNTPOINT" 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1}' || echo "unknown")
    else
        SIZE="unknown"
    fi

    # Determine if volume is critical (contains database or models)
    CRITICAL=false
    if echo "$vol" | grep -qi "db\|database\|postgres\|mysql\|mongo"; then
        CRITICAL=true
        CRITICAL_VOLUMES+=("$vol:Database volume (CRITICAL)")
    elif echo "$vol" | grep -qi "ollama\|model\|llm"; then
        CRITICAL=true
        CRITICAL_VOLUMES+=("$vol:AI models volume (LARGE)")
    fi

    # Display
    if [ "$CRITICAL" = true ]; then
        echo "📦 CRITICAL: $vol"
    else
        echo "📁 $vol"
    fi
    echo "   Created: $CREATED"
    echo "   Size: $SIZE"
    echo ""
done

# Critical volumes summary
if [ ${#CRITICAL_VOLUMES[@]} -gt 0 ]; then
    echo "--- Critical Data Volumes ---"
    for vol_info in "${CRITICAL_VOLUMES[@]}"; do
        vol_name="${vol_info%%:*}"
        vol_desc="${vol_info#*:}"
        echo "⚠️  $vol_name"
        echo "   $vol_desc"
    done
    echo ""
fi

# Volume removal warning
echo "╔════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗"
echo "║  ⚠️  ⚠️  ⚠️  VOLUME REMOVAL WARNING  ⚠️  ⚠️  ⚠️               ║"
echo "╚════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝"
echo ""
echo "NEVER run these commands:"
echo "  ❌ docker-compose down -v"
echo "  ❌ docker volume rm $PROJECT_NAME-*"
echo "  ❌ docker volume prune (without checking first)"
echo ""
echo "These will PERMANENTLY DELETE project data!"
echo ""

# Check if containers are using volumes
echo "--- Volume Usage ---"
for vol in $PROJECT_VOLUMES; do
    CONTAINERS=$(docker ps -a --filter volume="$vol" --format "{{.Names}}" | head -3)
    if [ -n "$CONTAINERS" ]; then
        echo "Volume: $vol"
        echo "  Used by: $CONTAINERS"
    fi
done
echo ""

# Safe operations reminder
echo "=== Safe Operations ==="
echo "✅ Restart: docker-compose restart"
echo "✅ Recreate: docker-compose up -d --force-recreate"
echo "✅ Stop/Start: docker-compose stop && docker-compose up -d"
echo "❌ NEVER: docker-compose down -v"
echo ""

echo "=== Volume Safety Check Complete ==="

    while [ "$dir" != "/" ]; do
        if [ -f "$dir/.env" ]; then

        fi
        dir=$(dirname "$dir")

    return 1

    echo "   Please run this from a project directory with database credentials"

DB_NAME="${POSTGRES_DB:-claude_memory}"
DB_PORT="${POSTGRES_HOST_PORT:-5432}"

# Find database container
PROJECT_NAME=$(basename "$(dirname "$ENV_FILE")" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]' | tr ' ' '-')
PREFIX=$(echo "$PROJECT_NAME" | cut -d'-' -f1)

DB_CONTAINER=$(docker ps --filter "name=$PREFIX" --format "{{.Names}}" | grep -E "db|postgres|mysql" | head -1)

if [ -z "$DB_CONTAINER" ]; then
    DB_CONTAINER=$(docker ps --format "{{.Names}}" | grep -E "db|postgres|mysql" | head -1)
fi

if [ -z "$DB_CONTAINER" ]; then
    echo "❌ Database container not found"
    echo "   Searched for containers matching: $PREFIX-*db, *postgres*, *mysql*"
    exit 1
fi

echo "=== Database Health Check ==="
echo "Container: $DB_CONTAINER"
echo "Database: $DB_NAME"
echo "User: $DB_USER"
echo ""

# Check if it's PostgreSQL or MySQL
DB_TYPE=""
if docker exec "$DB_CONTAINER" psql --version > /dev/null 2>&1; then
    DB_TYPE="postgresql"
elif docker exec "$DB_CONTAINER" mysql --version > /dev/null 2>&1; then
    DB_TYPE="mysql"
else
    echo "⚠️  Unknown database type"
    DB_TYPE="unknown"
fi

if [ "$DB_TYPE" = "postgresql" ]; then
    echo "Database Type: PostgreSQL"
    echo ""

    echo "--- Version ---"
    docker exec "$DB_CONTAINER" psql -U "$DB_USER" -d "$DB_NAME" -c "SELECT version();" -t 2>/dev/null || echo "Unable to get version"
    echo ""

    echo "--- Database Size ---"
    docker exec "$DB_CONTAINER" psql -U "$DB_USER" -d "$DB_NAME" -c "SELECT pg_database.datname, pg_size_pretty(pg_database_size(pg_database.datname)) AS size FROM pg_database WHERE datname = '$DB_NAME';" -t 2>/dev/null || echo "Unable to get size"
    echo ""

    echo "--- Connection Status ---"
    if docker exec "$DB_CONTAINER" pg_isready -U "$DB_USER" -d "$DB_NAME" > /dev/null 2>&1; then
        echo "✅ Database accepting connections"
    else
        echo "❌ Database not accepting connections"
    fi
    echo ""

    echo "--- Tables ---"
    TABLE_COUNT=$(docker exec "$DB_CONTAINER" psql -U "$DB_USER" -d "$DB_NAME" -t -c "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'public';" 2>/dev/null | xargs)
    echo "Total tables: $TABLE_COUNT"
    echo ""

    echo "--- Active Connections ---"
    docker exec "$DB_CONTAINER" psql -U "$DB_USER" -d "$DB_NAME" -c "SELECT COUNT(*) as active_connections FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE datname = '$DB_NAME';" -t 2>/dev/null || echo "Unable to get connection count"
    echo ""

elif [ "$DB_TYPE" = "mysql" ]; then
    echo "Database Type: MySQL"
    echo ""

    echo "--- Version ---"
    docker exec "$DB_CONTAINER" mysql -u "$DB_USER" -p"$MYSQL_PASSWORD" -e "SELECT VERSION();" 2>/dev/null || echo "Unable to get version"
    echo ""

    echo "--- Database Size ---"
    docker exec "$DB_CONTAINER" mysql -u "$DB_USER" -p"$MYSQL_PASSWORD" -e "SELECT table_schema AS 'Database', ROUND(SUM(data_length + index_length) / 1024 / 1024, 2) AS 'Size (MB)' FROM information_schema.TABLES WHERE table_schema = '$DB_NAME' GROUP BY table_schema;" 2>/dev/null || echo "Unable to get size"
    echo ""

    echo "--- Connection Status ---"
    if docker exec "$DB_CONTAINER" mysqladmin ping -u "$DB_USER" -p"$MYSQL_PASSWORD" > /dev/null 2>&1; then
        echo "✅ Database accepting connections"
    else
        echo "❌ Database not accepting connections"
    fi
    echo ""
fi

echo "=== Health Check Complete ==="

#!/bin/bash

echo "=== Volume Safety Check ==="
echo ""
echo "Date: $(date)"
echo ""

# Expected critical volumes
EXPECTED_VOLUMES=(
    "claude-memory-db-data:Database (context snapshots, skills, agent work)"
    "claude-memory-ollama:Ollama models (2GB+ downloads)"
)

# Check each expected volume
echo "--- Critical Volume Status ---"
ALL_PRESENT=true
MISSING_VOLUMES=()

for vol_info in "${EXPECTED_VOLUMES[@]}"; do
    vol_name="${vol_info%%:*}"
    vol_desc="${vol_info#*:}"
    
    if docker volume inspect "$vol_name" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        SIZE=$(docker volume inspect "$vol_name" --format "{{.Mountpoint}}" | xargs du -sh 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1}' || echo "unknown")
        CREATED=$(docker volume inspect "$vol_name" --format "{{.CreatedAt}}" 2>/dev/null | cut -d'T' -f1)
        echo "✅ $vol_name"
        echo "   Description: $vol_desc"
        echo "   Size: $SIZE"
        echo "   Created: $CREATED"
    else
        echo "❌ VIOLATION DETECTED: $vol_name"
        echo "   Description: $vol_desc"
        echo "   Status: VOLUME MISSING!"
        ALL_PRESENT=false
        MISSING_VOLUMES+=("$vol_name")
    fi
    echo ""
done

# Database-specific checks if volume exists
if docker volume inspect claude-memory-db-data >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "--- Database Content Check ---"
    
    # Check if database is accessible
    if docker exec claude-context-db psql -U memory_admin -d claude_memory -c "SELECT 1" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        # Count records
        SNAPSHOT_COUNT=$(docker exec claude-context-db psql -U memory_admin -d claude_memory -t -c "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM context_snapshots;" 2>/dev/null | xargs)
        SKILL_COUNT=$(docker exec claude-context-db psql -U memory_admin -d claude_memory -t -c "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM skills_agents WHERE is_active = TRUE;" 2>/dev/null | xargs)
        AGENT_WORK_COUNT=$(docker exec claude-context-db psql -U memory_admin -d claude_memory -t -c "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM agent_work;" 2>/dev/null | xargs)
        
        echo "Database contains:"
        echo "  • $SNAPSHOT_COUNT conversation snapshots"
        echo "  • $SKILL_COUNT active skills"
        echo "  • $AGENT_WORK_COUNT agent work records"
        
        # Warning if counts are suspiciously low
        if [ "$SNAPSHOT_COUNT" -lt 5 ]; then
            echo ""
            echo "⚠️  WARNING: Low snapshot count ($SNAPSHOT_COUNT)"
            echo "   This may indicate data loss or fresh installation"
        fi
        
        if [ "$SKILL_COUNT" -lt 3 ]; then
            echo ""
            echo "⚠️  WARNING: Low skill count ($SKILL_COUNT)"
            echo "   Expected at least 3-5 skills in production"
        fi
    else
        echo "⚠️  Database not accessible (may be starting up)"
    fi
    echo ""
fi

# Ollama model check if volume exists
if docker volume inspect claude-memory-ollama >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "--- Ollama Models Check ---"
    MODEL_COUNT=$(docker exec claude-ollama ollama list 2>/dev/null | tail -n +2 | wc -l | xargs)
    if [ "$MODEL_COUNT" -gt 0 ]; then
        echo "Models installed: $MODEL_COUNT"
        docker exec claude-ollama ollama list 2>/dev/null | head -4
    else
        echo "⚠️  WARNING: No models installed"
        echo "   Expected: llama3.2, mxbai-embed-large"
    fi
    echo ""
fi

# Violation report
if [ "$ALL_PRESENT" = false ]; then
    echo "╔════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗"
    echo "║  ⚠️  ⚠️  ⚠️   VOLUME VIOLATION DETECTED   ⚠️  ⚠️  ⚠️           ║"
    echo "╚════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝"
    echo ""
    echo "Missing volumes:"
    for vol in "${MISSING_VOLUMES[@]}"; do
        echo "  ❌ $vol"
    done
    echo ""
    echo "CRITICAL: Data loss has occurred!"
    echo ""
    echo "Possible causes:"
    echo "  1. docker-compose down -v (removes volumes)"
    echo "  2. docker volume rm claude-memory-*"
    echo "  3. Manual volume deletion"
    echo "  4. Fresh installation"
    echo ""

    echo "     docker cp backup.sql claude-context-db:/tmp/"
    echo "     docker exec claude-context-db psql -U memory_admin -d claude_memory < /tmp/backup.sql"
    echo ""
    echo "  2. Re-import skills from export:"
    echo "     python3 import-skill.py skills-backup.json"

else
    echo "╔════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗"

#!/bin/bash
# PORTABLE VERSION - dynamically detects project directory and volumes

# Detect project directory (where docker-compose.yml is)
find_docker_compose() {
    local dir="$PWD"
    while [ "$dir" != "/" ]; do
        if [ -f "$dir/docker-compose.yml" ] || [ -f "$dir/docker-compose.yaml" ]; then
            echo "$dir"
            return 0
        fi
        dir=$(dirname "$dir")
    done
    return 1
}

PROJECT_DIR=$(find_docker_compose)

if [ -z "$PROJECT_DIR" ]; then
    echo "❌ docker-compose.yml not found"
    echo "   Please run this from a docker-compose project directory"
    exit 1
fi

# Detect project name from docker-compose or directory name
if command -v docker-compose >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    PROJECT_NAME=$(cd "$PROJECT_DIR" && docker-compose config 2>/dev/null | grep "^name:" | head -1 | sed 's/^name: *//' | xargs 2>/dev/null)
fi

if [ -z "$PROJECT_NAME" ]; then
    PROJECT_NAME=$(basename "$PROJECT_DIR" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]' | tr ' ' '-')
fi

echo "=== Service Restart: $PROJECT_NAME ==="
echo "Project directory: $PROJECT_DIR"
echo ""

# Check if volumes exist
echo "--- Checking Volumes ---"
VOLUMES=$(docker volume ls --filter "name=$PROJECT_NAME" --format "{{.Name}}")

if [ -z "$VOLUMES" ]; then
    echo "⚠️  WARNING: No volumes found for project '$PROJECT_NAME'"
    echo "   This may indicate:"
    echo "   • Fresh installation (no volumes created yet)"
    echo "   • Volumes were previously removed"
    echo "   • Project name mismatch"
else
    echo "Found $(echo "$VOLUMES" | wc -l | xargs) volume(s):"
    for vol in $VOLUMES; do
        SIZE=$(docker volume inspect "$vol" --format "{{.Mountpoint}}" 2>/dev/null | xargs -I {} sudo du -sh {} 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1}' || echo "unknown")

        # Detect critical volumes
        CRITICAL=""
        if echo "$vol" | grep -qi "db\|database\|postgres\|mysql"; then
            CRITICAL=" (⚠️  CRITICAL - database)"
        elif echo "$vol" | grep -qi "ollama\|model\|llm"; then
            CRITICAL=" (📦 LARGE - AI models)"
        fi

        echo "  ✅ $vol (size: $SIZE)$CRITICAL"
    done
fi
echo ""

# Volume removal warning
echo "╔════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗"
echo "║  ⚠️  ⚠️  ⚠️  VOLUME REMOVAL WARNING  ⚠️  ⚠️  ⚠️               ║"
echo "╚════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝"
echo ""
echo "NEVER run these commands:"
echo "  ❌ docker-compose down -v"
echo "  ❌ docker volume rm $PROJECT_NAME-*"
echo "  ❌ docker volume prune (without checking first)"
echo ""
echo "These will PERMANENTLY DELETE project data!"
echo ""

echo "=== Safe Restart Options ==="
echo ""
echo "1. RECOMMENDED: Restart containers only (keeps volumes)"
echo "2. Stop and start (keeps volumes)"
echo "3. Recreate containers only (keeps volumes)"
echo "4. Down and up (SAFE - does NOT remove volumes by default)"
echo ""

# Ask user which option
read -p "Select option (1-4) or c to cancel: " option

case $option in
    1)
        echo ""
        echo "🔄 Restarting containers (keeps volumes)..."
        cd "$PROJECT_DIR" && docker-compose restart
        echo "✅ Services restarted successfully"
        ;;
    2)
        echo ""
        echo "🛑 Stopping containers..."
        cd "$PROJECT_DIR" && docker-compose stop
        echo "🚀 Starting containers..."
        cd "$PROJECT_DIR" && docker-compose up -d
        echo "✅ Services restarted successfully"
        ;;
    3)
        echo ""
        echo "🔄 Recreating containers (keeps volumes)..."
        cd "$PROJECT_DIR" && docker-compose up -d --force-recreate
        echo "✅ Containers recreated successfully"
        ;;
    4)
        echo ""
        echo "⚠️  WARNING: This will stop all containers"
        echo "   Volumes will NOT be removed (safe)"
        read -p "Type YES to confirm: " confirm
        if [ "$confirm" = "YES" ]; then
            echo ""
            echo "🛑 Stopping and removing containers..."
            cd "$PROJECT_DIR" && docker-compose down
            echo "🚀 Starting services..."
            cd "$PROJECT_DIR" && docker-compose up -d
            echo "✅ Services restarted successfully"
        else
            echo "❌ Cancelled"
            exit 1
        fi
        ;;
    c|C)
        echo "❌ Cancelled"
        exit 1
        ;;
    *)
        echo "❌ Invalid option"
        exit 1
        ;;
esac

echo ""
echo "--- Service Status After Restart ---"
docker ps --filter "name=$PROJECT_NAME" --format "table {{.Names}}\t{{.Status}}"
echo ""
echo "=== Restart Complete ==="

#!/bin/bash
# PORTABLE VERSION - dynamically detects project and containers

# Detect project name from docker-compose or directory name
find_docker_compose() {
    local dir="$PWD"
    while [ "$dir" != "/" ]; do
        if [ -f "$dir/docker-compose.yml" ] || [ -f "$dir/docker-compose.yaml" ]; then
            echo "$dir"
            return 0
        fi
        dir=$(dirname "$dir")
    done
    return 1
}

PROJECT_DIR=$(find_docker_compose)

if [ -z "$PROJECT_DIR" ]; then
    echo "⚠️  docker-compose.yml not found - showing all containers"
    PROJECT_NAME=""
else
    # Detect project name from docker-compose
    if command -v docker-compose >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        PROJECT_NAME=$(cd "$PROJECT_DIR" && docker-compose config 2>/dev/null | grep "^name:" | head -1 | sed 's/^name: *//' | xargs 2>/dev/null)
    fi

    if [ -z "$PROJECT_NAME" ]; then
        PROJECT_NAME=$(basename "$PROJECT_DIR" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]' | tr ' ' '-')
    fi
fi

echo "=== System Status: ${PROJECT_NAME:-All Containers} ==="
echo ""
echo "Date: $(date)"
[ -n "$PROJECT_DIR" ] && echo "Project directory: $PROJECT_DIR"
echo ""

echo "--- Docker Containers ---"
if [ -n "$PROJECT_NAME" ]; then
    # Try to find containers related to this project
    # First try exact project name match
    CONTAINERS=$(docker ps --filter "name=$PROJECT_NAME" --format "{{.Names}}")

    # If no containers found, try shortened version (e.g., claude-memory -> claude)
    if [ -z "$CONTAINERS" ]; then
        PREFIX=$(echo "$PROJECT_NAME" | cut -d'-' -f1)
        CONTAINERS=$(docker ps --filter "name=$PREFIX" --format "{{.Names}}")
    fi

    if [ -n "$CONTAINERS" ]; then
        docker ps --filter "name=$PREFIX" --format "table {{.Names}}\t{{.Status}}\t{{.Ports}}"
    else
        echo "No containers found for project: $PROJECT_NAME"
    fi
else
    docker ps --format "table {{.Names}}\t{{.Status}}\t{{.Ports}}"
fi
echo ""

# Determine search prefix (first part of project name, e.g., "claude" from "claude-memory")
if [ -n "$PROJECT_NAME" ]; then
    PREFIX=$(echo "$PROJECT_NAME" | cut -d'-' -f1)
else
    PREFIX=""
fi

# Find database container (try common patterns)
if [ -n "$PREFIX" ]; then
    DB_CONTAINER=$(docker ps --filter "name=$PREFIX" --format "{{.Names}}" | grep -E "db|postgres|mysql" | head -1)
else
    DB_CONTAINER=$(docker ps --format "{{.Names}}" | grep -E "db|postgres|mysql" | head -1)
fi

# Find processor container
if [ -n "$PREFIX" ]; then
    PROCESSOR_CONTAINER=$(docker ps --filter "name=$PREFIX" --format "{{.Names}}" | grep -E "processor|api|backend" | head -1)
else
    PROCESSOR_CONTAINER=$(docker ps --format "{{.Names}}" | grep -E "processor|api|backend" | head -1)
fi

# Find Ollama container
if [ -n "$PREFIX" ]; then
    OLLAMA_CONTAINER=$(docker ps --filter "name=$PREFIX" --format "{{.Names}}" | grep -i "ollama" | head -1)
else
    OLLAMA_CONTAINER=$(docker ps --format "{{.Names}}" | grep -i "ollama" | head -1)
fi

echo "--- Service Health ---"

# Database health check
if [ -n "$DB_CONTAINER" ]; then
    # Try PostgreSQL
    if docker exec "$DB_CONTAINER" pg_isready > /dev/null 2>&1; then
        echo "✅ Database ($DB_CONTAINER): Healthy"
    # Try MySQL
    elif docker exec "$DB_CONTAINER" mysqladmin ping > /dev/null 2>&1; then
        echo "✅ Database ($DB_CONTAINER): Healthy"
    else
        echo "⚠️  Database ($DB_CONTAINER): Not responding"
    fi
else
    echo "⚠️  Database: Container not found"
fi

# Processor health check (try common ports)
PROCESSOR_HEALTHY=false
for port in 3200 3000 8080 8000; do
    if curl -s http://localhost:$port/health > /dev/null 2>&1; then
        echo "✅ Processor: Healthy (port $port)"
        PROCESSOR_HEALTHY=true
        break
    fi
done
if [ "$PROCESSOR_HEALTHY" = false ]; then
    if [ -n "$PROCESSOR_CONTAINER" ]; then
        echo "⚠️  Processor ($PROCESSOR_CONTAINER): Not responding"
    else
        echo "⚠️  Processor: Container not found"
    fi
fi

# Ollama health check
if [ -n "$OLLAMA_CONTAINER" ]; then
    if curl -s http://localhost:11434/api/tags > /dev/null 2>&1; then
        echo "✅ Ollama ($OLLAMA_CONTAINER): Healthy"
    else
        echo "⚠️  Ollama ($OLLAMA_CONTAINER): Not responding"
    fi
else
    echo "⚠️  Ollama: Container not found"
fi
echo ""

# Database statistics (if database container exists)
if [ -n "$DB_CONTAINER" ]; then
    echo "--- Database Statistics ---"

    # Detect database type and user
    if docker exec "$DB_CONTAINER" psql --version > /dev/null 2>&1; then
        # PostgreSQL
        DB_USER=$(docker exec "$DB_CONTAINER" printenv POSTGRES_USER 2>/dev/null || echo "postgres")
        DB_NAME=$(docker exec "$DB_CONTAINER" printenv POSTGRES_DB 2>/dev/null || echo "postgres")

        # Try to get stats
        docker exec "$DB_CONTAINER" psql -U "$DB_USER" -d "$DB_NAME" -t -c "
        SELECT
            'Tables: ' || COUNT(*)
        FROM information_schema.tables
        WHERE table_schema = 'public';
        " 2>/dev/null | sed 's/^[ \t]*//' || echo "Statistics unavailable"
    fi
    echo ""
fi

echo "--- Disk Usage ---"
df -h /var/lib/docker 2>/dev/null | tail -1 | awk '{print "Docker volumes: " $3 " used / " $2 " total (" $5 " full)"}' || echo "Docker disk info unavailable"
echo ""

# Ollama models (if Ollama container exists)
if [ -n "$OLLAMA_CONTAINER" ]; then
    echo "--- Ollama Models ---"
    docker exec "$OLLAMA_CONTAINER" ollama list 2>/dev/null | head -5 || echo "Ollama models unavailable"
    echo ""
fi

# Volume information
if [ -n "$PROJECT_NAME" ]; then
    VOLUMES=$(docker volume ls --filter "name=$PROJECT_NAME" --format "{{.Name}}")
    if [ -n "$VOLUMES" ]; then
        echo "--- Volumes ---"
        echo "$VOLUMES" | while read vol; do
            echo "  • $vol"
        done
        echo ""
    fi
fi

echo "=== Status Check Complete ==="

#!/bin/bash

echo "╔══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗"
echo "║           PROJECT ORIENTATION - Where Am I?                      ║"
echo "╚══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝"
echo ""

# ==============================================================================
# SECTION 1: FIND CLAUDE.MD (SOURCE OF TRUTH)
# ==============================================================================
echo "=== Looking for Claude Project Documentation ==="
echo ""

CLAUDE_MD=""
CLAUDE_DIR=""

# Check common locations
if [ -f ".claude/CLAUDE.md" ]; then
    CLAUDE_MD=".claude/CLAUDE.md"
    CLAUDE_DIR=".claude"
elif [ -f ".claude.md" ]; then
    CLAUDE_MD=".claude.md"
elif [ -f "CLAUDE.md" ]; then
    CLAUDE_MD="CLAUDE.md"
fi

if [ -n "$CLAUDE_MD" ]; then
    echo "✅ Found Claude documentation: $CLAUDE_MD"
    echo ""
    echo "━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━"
    echo "📖 PROJECT CONTEXT (from $CLAUDE_MD)"
    echo "━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━"
    echo ""

    # Display the CLAUDE.md content
    cat "$CLAUDE_MD"

    echo ""
    echo "━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━"
    echo ""
else
    echo "⚠️  No Claude documentation found (.claude/CLAUDE.md)"
    echo ""
    echo "Searched for:"
    echo "  - .claude/CLAUDE.md"
    echo "  - .claude.md"
    echo "  - CLAUDE.md"
    echo ""
    echo "I'll discover project details and offer to create one..."
    echo ""
fi

# ==============================================================================
# SECTION 2: DISCOVER PROJECT ASSETS
# ==============================================================================
echo "=== Discovering Project Assets ==="
echo ""

# Basic info
DIR_NAME=$(basename "$PWD")
echo "📁 Current Directory: $PWD"
echo "📦 Project Name: $DIR_NAME"
echo ""

# Git info
if [ -d ".git" ]; then
    GIT_REMOTE=$(git remote get-url origin 2>/dev/null || echo "No remote")
    GIT_BRANCH=$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null || echo "unknown")
    LAST_COMMIT=$(git log -1 --format="%h - %s (%ar)" 2>/dev/null || echo "No commits")

    echo "🔀 Git Repository:"
    echo "   Remote: $GIT_REMOTE"
    echo "   Branch: $GIT_BRANCH"
    echo "   Last Commit: $LAST_COMMIT"
    echo ""
fi

# Docker Compose
COMPOSE_FILE=""
COMPOSE_PROJECT=""
if [ -f "docker-compose.yml" ]; then
    COMPOSE_FILE="docker-compose.yml"
elif [ -f "docker-compose.yaml" ]; then
    COMPOSE_FILE="docker-compose.yaml"
fi

if [ -n "$COMPOSE_FILE" ]; then
    echo "🐳 Docker Compose: $COMPOSE_FILE"

    else

    fi
    echo "   Project: $COMPOSE_PROJECT"

    # Services
    SERVICE_COUNT=$(docker-compose config --services 2>/dev/null | wc -l | xargs || echo "0")

# Containers

fi

# Volumes
if [ -n "$COMPOSE_PROJECT" ]; then

    if [ -n "$VOLUMES" ]; then
        echo "💾 Volumes:"
        for vol in $VOLUMES; do
            # Detect critical volumes
            CRITICAL=""
            [[ "$vol" =~ db|database|postgres|mysql ]] && CRITICAL=" (⚠️  CRITICAL - database)"
            [[ "$vol" =~ ollama|model|llm ]] && CRITICAL=" (📦 LARGE - AI models)"

            echo "   - $vol$CRITICAL"

fi

# Environment files
if [ -f ".env" ]; then

    echo "🔐 Environment Variables (.env): $ENV_COUNT defined"
    echo ""
fi

# Claude Code config
if [ -d ".claude" ]; then
    echo "⚙️  Claude Code Configuration:"
    [ -f ".claude/settings.json" ] && echo "   ✅ settings.json"
    [ -d ".claude/commands" ] && SKILL_COUNT=$(ls -1 .claude/commands/*.md 2>/dev/null | wc -l | xargs) && echo "   ✅ commands/ ($SKILL_COUNT slash commands)"
    [ -d ".claude/rules" ] && RULE_COUNT=$(ls -1 .claude/rules/*.md 2>/dev/null | wc -l | xargs) && echo "   ✅ rules/ ($RULE_COUNT rule files)"
    echo ""
fi

# ==============================================================================
# SECTION 3: OFFER TO CREATE/UPDATE CLAUDE.MD
# ==============================================================================
if [ -z "$CLAUDE_MD" ]; then
    echo "╔══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗"
    echo "║                 CREATE CLAUDE.MD DOCUMENTATION?                  ║"
    echo "╚══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝"
    echo ""
    echo "I discovered project assets but no CLAUDE.md exists."
    echo "This file helps Claude understand the project quickly."
    echo ""
    echo "Would you like me to:"
    echo "  1. Create .claude/CLAUDE.md with discovered info"
    echo "  2. Create CLAUDE.md at project root"
    echo "  3. Skip (just show current state)"
    echo ""
    read -p "Select option (1-3): " CREATE_OPTION

    case $CREATE_OPTION in
        1)
            echo ""
            echo "Creating .claude/CLAUDE.md..."
            mkdir -p .claude

            cat > .claude/CLAUDE.md <<EOF
# $(echo "$DIR_NAME" | tr '-' ' ' | tr '_' ' ' | awk '{for(i=1;i<=NF;i++) $i=toupper(substr($i,1,1)) tolower(substr($i,2));}1') - Project Context

**Project Root:** \`$PWD\`
**Auto-discovered:** $(date +%Y-%m-%d)

---

## Quick Context

EOF

            # Add git info if available
            if [ -d ".git" ]; then
                cat >> .claude/CLAUDE.md <<EOF
### Git Repository
- **Remote:** $GIT_REMOTE
- **Branch:** $GIT_BRANCH
- **Last Commit:** $LAST_COMMIT

EOF
            fi

            # Add Docker info if available
            if [ -n "$COMPOSE_FILE" ]; then
                cat >> .claude/CLAUDE.md <<EOF
### Docker Infrastructure
- **Compose File:** $COMPOSE_FILE
- **Project Name:** $COMPOSE_PROJECT
- **Services:** $SERVICE_COUNT

EOF
                if [ "$SERVICE_COUNT" -gt 0 ]; then
                    echo "**Service List:**" >> .claude/CLAUDE.md
                    docker-compose config --services 2>/dev/null | sed 's/^/- /' >> .claude/CLAUDE.md
                    echo "" >> .claude/CLAUDE.md
                fi
            fi

            # Add volumes if critical
            if [ -n "$VOLUMES" ]; then
                cat >> .claude/CLAUDE.md <<EOF
### Critical Volumes (⚠️  DO NOT DELETE)

EOF
                for vol in $VOLUMES; do
                    if [[ "$vol" =~ db|database|postgres|mysql|ollama|model ]]; then
                        echo "- \`$vol\` - Contains persistent data" >> .claude/CLAUDE.md
                    fi
                done
                echo "" >> .claude/CLAUDE.md
            fi

            # Add footer
            cat >> .claude/CLAUDE.md <<EOF

---

## Important Notes

<!-- Add project-specific notes here -->

---

**Last Updated:** $(date +%Y-%m-%d)
**Next Review:** Update when significant changes occur
EOF

            echo "✅ Created .claude/CLAUDE.md"
            echo ""
            echo "You can edit it to add:"
            echo "  - Project description"
            echo "  - Setup instructions"
            echo "  - Important paths"
            echo "  - Custom workflows"
            ;;

        2)
            echo ""
            echo "Creating CLAUDE.md at project root..."
            # Similar content but at root
            cat > CLAUDE.md <<EOF
# $DIR_NAME

**Project discovered:** $(date +%Y-%m-%d)

## Overview

<!-- Add project description -->

## Quick Start

<!-- Add setup instructions -->

## Docker Services

$(if [ -n "$COMPOSE_PROJECT" ]; then echo "Project: $COMPOSE_PROJECT"; docker-compose config --services 2>/dev/null | sed 's/^/- /'; fi)

## Important Paths

<!-- Add key directories and files -->

---

**Auto-generated by Claude Code project orientation**
EOF

            echo "✅ Created CLAUDE.md at project root"
            ;;

        *)
            echo "Skipped."
            ;;
    esac
else
    # CLAUDE.md exists - offer to append discovered info
    echo "=== Validation Check ==="
    echo ""
    echo "Checking if discovered assets match CLAUDE.md documentation..."
    echo ""

    # Check if containers mentioned match reality
    if [ -n "$CONTAINERS" ]; then
        RUNNING_CONTAINERS=$(echo "$CONTAINERS" | wc -l | xargs)
        echo "Running containers: $RUNNING_CONTAINERS"

        # Simple validation
        if grep -q "docker" "$CLAUDE_MD" 2>/dev/null; then

    # Check volumes

#!/bin/bash
# Monitor Capture Progress Skill
# Wrapper script to run the Python monitoring script

# Find claude-memory installation directory
# Walk up from current directory to find monitor-capture-progress.py
find_script() {
    local dir="$PWD"
    while [ "$dir" != "/" ]; do
        if [ -f "$dir/monitor-capture-progress.py" ]; then
            echo "$dir/monitor-capture-progress.py"
            return 0
        fi
        dir=$(dirname "$dir")
    done
    
    # Fallback: check script's own directory
    SCRIPT_DIR="$( cd "$( dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}" )" && pwd )"
    if [ -f "$SCRIPT_DIR/../monitor-capture-progress.py" ]; then
        echo "$SCRIPT_DIR/../monitor-capture-progress.py"
        return 0
    fi
    
    return 1
}

MONITOR_SCRIPT=$(find_script)

if [ -z "$MONITOR_SCRIPT" ]; then
    echo "❌ monitor-capture-progress.py not found"
    echo "   Expected location: claude-memory project root"
    exit 1
fi

# Run monitoring script with all arguments passed through
python3 "$MONITOR_SCRIPT" "$@"
